from module import memo

def test_cache_hit_for_same_args():
    first = memo(10)
    second = memo(10)
    assert first == second == 100
    assert memo.cache_info().hits >= 1

def test_cache_miss_for_new_args():
    assert memo(11) == 121
    assert memo.cache_info().misses >= 1

def test_multiple_args_cached():
    assert memo(12) == 144
    assert memo(12) == 144

from breaker import CircuitBreaker

def test_trips_open_after_failures():
    cb = CircuitBreaker(threshold=2)
    cb.record(False)
    assert cb.state == 'closed'
    cb.record(False)
    assert cb.state == 'open'

def test_success_resets_to_closed():
    cb = CircuitBreaker(threshold=2)
    cb.record(False)
    cb.record(True)
    assert cb.state == 'closed'
    assert cb.failures == 0
